zoe: Starting eu-west embed-service canary (v1.4.1) in change window. plan 10% -> 40% -> 100% over 20m. Watch p95, 5xx, and kvcache miss rate. tagging @oncall.

deploy-bot: [deploy] embed-service v1.4.1 -> canary start at 10% in eu-west. id=deploy-1745678902. preflight OK.

slo-bot: SLO snapshot: baseline p95=200ms, current p95=205ms (+2.5%), 5xx=0.01%, kvcache_miss=1.0x

liam: opening dash and traces. will watch closely for tail.

zoe: if p95 > +12% or 5xx > 0.5% we pause and consider pin to v1.3.3. pin command: `deploy-bot pin-version embed-service v1.3.3 --reason "canary regression"`

liam: slight tail blip at +15m: p95 jumped to +14% for ~2m, no 5xx increase. kvcache miss rate spiked 3x.

slo-bot: alert: eu-west.embed.p95_delta > 12% (2m aggregate). firing runbook check.

infra-bot: observed autoscaler spin-up on canary nodes; added 1 replica. Nothing OOM.

zoe: manual kvcache flush on canary nodes performed. p95 down to +4% after flush.

liam: recommend hold at 10% for one more 5m window to observe.

slo-bot: rule eu-west.embed.5xx_rate remains below threshold at 0.02%.

deploy-bot: canary hold engaged. backoff timer set to 5m.

zoe: agree to hold. if we see repeated kvcache miss spikes we'll pin. filing a rollback pin ticket as a precaution.

liam: will post another update at t+8m and attach a short trace sample.

infra-bot: note: upstream auth service returned a single 502 within the spike window — correlating traces but not causal yet.

zoe: thanks all. stand by for status update. :thumbsup:
